description: Register a principal at the identity door with a wallet signature and get its ONE-TIME key (never shown again) — the orderbook's account. Sign `taifoon_orderbook_register_message` (this tool returns it when `signature` is absent) with the operator wallet (EIP-191 personal_sign); one principal per wallet; the key then deposits from and withdraws to that wallet.

operator.description: the wallet (0x…) that signs; deposits come from it, withdrawals go to it

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the message; omit to get the exact message to sign

signed_at.description: unix seconds in the message (10-minute window)

name: taifoon_orderbook_register
